Even if tries to stop talking to her without acknowledging her belief, she will still make this request.

After speaking to , receives the "" , prompting him to return to Aliza once he has found the . can further interrogate Aliza about the "legendary hero" and the . When asked about the hero, explains that he appears with the whenever threatens . If inquires about the , she will inform him that the stories she heard of it say that it was put to rest in a , awaiting its owner's return.

After acquiring the , can return to and state his status as the hero. has already acquired the before speaking to , she will discover that he is the hero regardless of how reacts in return to her.}} She states that the he carries is proof of this.
